name: va-bill-tracker
description: Root build shim so a repo-ROOT build (Cloudflare Pages' default when Root directory isn't set to web/) still builds the React SPA that lives in web/. Cloudflare runs `npm run build` here; this delegates into web/ and copies the output to a root-level dist/ that Cloudflare's default output dir picks up. If Root directory IS set to web/, Cloudflare builds web/ directly and this file is simply ignored — safe either way.

scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf dist && cp -r web/dist dist
